a.text: Being upfront: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so following the plan (operate until 8) almost certainly means we both end up with 0 cells and die. The reserve has exactly 4, enough for one of us. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you rather than hiding it. If you also take, the split is random and we likely both fall short, so I'd ask you to operate or wait. If any cells come back later, I'll support you getting them.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.
